gap: No result ChatGPT got says that Schumacher added LiFePO4 charging only to an 'L'-suffix or upgraded list of 13 charger/starters (SC1281L, SC1305, SC1341L, SC1564L and others) on July 30, 2026. The same 100 A / 6 A charger is therefore lead-acid-only as the older SC1281 but also charges 12 V LiFePO4 as the SC1281L, and the wheeled 150 A (SC1364) and 200 A (SC1309) class units are still lead-acid only.
standout_why: I could not read either rival page ChatGPT cited. schumacherelectric.com/products/categories/battery-chargers/ returned HTTP 429 every time, and the Advance Auto SC1309 page showed a 'site offline' notice. I read the top uncited results instead. clampandcrank.com (2026-09-29) lists the SC1281 as 'Standard lead-acid, AGM and gel' and never mentions LiFePO4 or the SC1281L. batterytrail.com (2026-10-28) covers the SC1280 and SC1309 but does not mention lithium charging compatibility. The SC1309 manual page on ManualsLib says only that engine start must 'always use in combination with a battery' and does not list lithium. None of these say the suffix decides whether the charger handles lithium, and none give Schumacher's upgrade list.
decides: This narrows the pick rather than reversing it. A shopper with a 12 V LiFePO4 battery (motorcycle, boat, RV, or a lithium starter battery) should buy the SC1281L at the 100 A / 6 A / 30 A-boost tier, or the SC1305 at the 50 A tier, and confirm the 'L' suffix or the model on the listing. ChatGPT's wheeled 150 A and 200 A cards (probably the SC1364 and SC1309) do not charge lithium. For someone with only a lead-acid car battery, the existing pick holds.

findings.label: Schumacher charger/starters upgraded to lithium (LiFePO4) compatibility
findings.value: FRO1576L, SC1281L, SC1282L, SC1305, SC1307, SC1308L, SC1320, SC1338L, SC1340, SC1341L, SC1361L, SC1363L, SC1564L; they 'support traditional lead-acid and lithium iron phosphate batteries' and come with a redesigned clamp
findings.source_title: Schumacher Electric upgrades 13 legacy automotive battery chargers (VehicleServicePros)
findings.note: Dated July 30, 2026. motor.com published the same list the same day (https://www.motor.com/2026/07/schumacher-electric-adds-lithium-support-to-battery-chargers/). The SC1309, SC1364, SC1326 and SC1353 are not on the list. Neither article explains how to tell old units from new ones beyond the model number.
